visualCharacteristics.structure: image + badge + name + price + specs + link

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: cell 1 = product image; cell 2 = optional badge paragraph, product-name heading (link to PDP), optional short sub-label, "Starting at" + price paragraph, spec bullet list, link (button). Badge/heading/sub-label render above the image. A row without a heading (merchandising promo) keeps authored order.
contentPattern.notes: Only 9 of 52 products are in the server-rendered DOM; author decides whether to add the rest manually. The inline promo tile ('Unlock 10% Off the Accessories You Need', TAKE10ACC, 'Shop and Save') can be authored as a 10th row or dropped.
